run_training_loop: run a configurable PyTorch Lightning training loop with model, data loaders, and trainer from a DictConfig
load_model_from_checkpoint: load model weights from a checkpoint file into a LightningModule with configurable strict and freeze options
instantiate_data_loaders: instantiate training and validation DataLoader objects from a configuration structure
instantiate_trainer: instantiate a PyTorch Lightning Trainer engine from a configuration structure
fit_model: fit a LightningModule using training and validation data loaders with a configured Trainer
